programme.title: Chloe Ashby On Holiday Romances & Friendship In Your 40s
programme.desc: For 20 years Maggie and Will have spent idyllic summers in the south of France with their friends Lydia and Roland. This year, tension is brewing and loyalties are being tested. Their young kids are all there too, and they might stumble upon secrets that were being kept from them. Author Chloe Ashby discusses her novel Family Friends with Fearne Cotton, exploring relationship dynamics around the age of 40.

programme.title: Gary and Emma Neville: Early Menopause Changed Us Forever
programme.desc: Fearne sits down with Gary and Emma Neville to talk about love, their life together, and the challenges they've faced together. Emma shares her experience of going through menopause in her 40s, and how it has impacted her both physically and emotionally.

programme.title: Gillian Anderson On Not Being Ashamed Of Your Fantasies
programme.desc: Gillian Anderson joins Happy Place to discuss her new book 'Want', exploring the complexities of women's sexual fantasies and the importance of being open about them with ourselves and our partners. Gillian shares how her various roles from The X-Files to Sex Education have informed the person she is today. A 50-minute conversation about sex, confidence, and being a woman.

programme.title: David Tennant On The Struggles Throughout His Acting Career
programme.desc: David Tennant discusses the anxieties and stage fright he experiences as an actor, even with critical acclaim, and how a little fear can be useful to prevent complacency. He and Fearne explore how to work through moments when anxiety threatens to overwhelm you, and how concrete experiences over time provide a coping mechanism. David also shares his thoughts on whether celebrities should use their platform for social activism, and verifies some stories from online about his life.

programme.title: Ant & Dec On Anxiety, Gratitude & Turning 50
programme.desc: In their first ever podcast appearance, Ant and Dec join Fearne and explain that nearly four decades into their careers they're still laughing together just as much as they did at the beginning, but now they've got far more gratitude for each day they get to be on TV.

programme.title: Caitlin Moran On How She Finally Calmed Her Nervous System
programme.desc: Writer Caitlin Moran discusses her 30-year battle with anxiety that began at age 13, and how she's now two years anxiety-free through choosing to be hopeful and see the good in life. She talks with Fearne Cotton about how social media has altered our perception of reality, the difference between posting angrily online and taking real-world action, social anxiety when meeting friends, and how presuming everyone's having a bad day can make you happier.

programme.title: Ashley Roberts On Coping With Anxiety And Insomnia
programme.desc: Ashley Roberts discusses her journey through burnout and body shaming during the height of the Pussycat Dolls' fame, and how discovering breathwork helped her recover from intense anxiety and physical ill-health. She talks about her mental health toolkit, the grief of losing her dad to suicide, and family mental illness. With Fearne Cotton, she shares experiences of insomnia and coping strategies.

programme.title: Adam Kay Opens Up About The PTSD That Made Him Leave The NHS
programme.desc: Former doctor Adam Kay discusses the traumatic day at work that left him with PTSD and led to his decision to leave the NHS. He explains how the experience affected his mental health, leaving him feeling paranoid and overcautious, and how he turned to diary writing to process his emotions. Adam and Fearne discuss mental health stigma in the workplace and at home, and offer advice for building mental health toolkits for crises of varying severity. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicide.

programme.title: Patric Gagne: 5% Of People Are Sociopaths
programme.desc: Sociopathy is a spectrum disorder affecting roughly 5% of the population. Patric Gagne is a sociopath who explains the difference between psychopaths and sociopaths. While sociopaths have access to inherent emotions like sadness and happiness, they struggle with learned social emotions like remorse, guilt, empathy, and love. Patric describes the apathy she experiences, which in the past led to anti-social behaviours like stealing cars and breaking into houses.

programme.title: Goth Bride
programme.desc: They say anything goes in Hollywood, but wedding planner David Tutera is shocked to find out that bride Christina wants a wedding based on black. And she means it – Christina shows David a black bridal gown, black bridesmaids' dresses and finally a tiny black flower girl dress for her darling seven-year old daughter! Even her fiancé Eric tells David the wedding should be black, dark and creepy to fit their all-goth fashion style! David finds himself surrounded by enough skeletons, skulls and spiders to decorate a Halloween party, but nothing in wedding white. And when he takes Christina to a bridal shop filled with white dresses, she nearly has an anxiety attack! David has to find out just what makes this adorable goth bride tick, and when he does, he delivers a high-fashion, romantic wedding that's perfect for Christina.

programme.title: Fashionista Bride

This shopaholic bride is even confused about her theme - she wants a frivolous, flouncy Marie-Antoinette look with some rustic birch logs and confetti thrown in for good measure! David comes to the rescue of this good-hearted fashionista and turns her wedding into a runway success.

programme.title: Tuscany Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera loves Tuscany, Italy, and so does his latest bride Jane. She wants a romantic outdoor wedding, but her vision of what Tuscany looks like is more than a little skewed, and her bright orange bridesmaid's dresses are only adding to the disaster. Worst of all, the bride, the groom, and the father-of-the-bride just lost their jobs and the wedding plans are going up in smoke. David Tutera will need all his skill and savvy to create the perfect Tuscan wedding in southern California.

programme.title: Dragonfly Bride
programme.desc: Bride Regina lost a child and wants a dragonfly-themed wedding as a symbol of hope. David Tutera has his work cut out for him, having to convince the bride that she deserves every part of the gorgeous garden wedding he's creating. The wedding dress Regina bought on sale is already frayed, and the bridesmaid's dresses are all different shades of green -- David's least favorite color for fashion. What's more, Regina and her fiancé are planning a backyard wedding with no food for the guests! David has one surprise after another for this sweet-natured bride, culminating in an emotional fairy-tale wedding with larger-than-life entertainment.

programme.title: Hollywood Glam Bride
programme.desc: Bride Benita is an actress that wants a Hollywood glam wedding, but she's procrastinated on all the details. Her decorations are better suited to a child's birthday party, and the bridesmaids' dresses remind wedding planner David Tutera of a tube sock! He sees none of the Old Hollywood glitz and glam Benita and her actor fiancé Arlen say they want. David decides to take his bride and groom back in time, trying on wedding fashions from the forties, fifties, and sixties. Can he pull together a swinging, classy affair in time for this bride and groom to say I do?

programme.title: Spots and Stripes
programme.desc: Whether spots or stripes, markings can be used for anything from communication to cooling. What look like standout fashion statements to us can help animals vanish completely into a landscape. The design possibilities are endless, and vary to suit the terrain and geography. Whatever their remarkable uses, spots and stripes adorn some of the most iconic animals in the natural world. Camouflage or decoration, we can thank both spots and stripes for handing these creatures their unique and majestic beauty.

programme.title: Mountains
programme.desc: Mountains define some of our most spectacular landscapes, creating a mosaic of dramatic habitats, teaming with incredible wildlife. Mountains are found on every continent on Earth, covering 22% of the planet's surface. They're a vital part of our ecosystem a quarter of terrestrial animal and plant species live in mountains and they house an incredible 85% of all amphibians, mammals and birds. It's no wonder that so many cultures consider mountains sacred places: gateways to the heavens.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Stewart Island, New Zealand's third largest and southernmost island, is a place of dramatic beauty and unpredictability. Here, the Pot-bellied Seahorse father has extra responsibilities, the Octopus is both hunter and hunted, and 82 Great White Sharks need to eat, too. Standing at just 30cm and weighing only 1 kg, the Little Blue Penguin is nonetheless a swift swimmer and a determined parent.

programme.title: Rottnest Island: Kingdom Of The Quokka
programme.desc: Islands worldwide are grand experiments in nature, with their isolation creating unique conditions for animals to diverge from the norm. On the far west of the Australian continent lies Rottnest Island where one of the worlds ‘happiest', yet most vulnerable marsupials the Quokka thrives. How do they survive here in such inhospitable conditions and nowhere else? In a world first, the entire life cycle of the Quokka will be filmed using special natural history filming techniques to expose the secrets of its survival mechanisms.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: The endless plains of East Africa is a paradise for lions. The most social of all cats, lions form prides that are unlike any other animals. Together, they'll hunt, raise their young and defend their territory. With such a close family and plentiful home, the pride welcomes new babies every year. But new children introduces new dangers. The cubs will have to trust their instincts, their mother and the power of the pride if they are to make it to adulthood and take their place on the African plains.

programme.title: Lions Rule
programme.desc: On the African plains lions rule. They're not the biggest or fastest animals around, but stealth, teamwork and the strength of the pride means they almost always come out on top.

programme.title: Jaguar
programme.desc: One of the most powerful yet elusive animals on the planet, we follow one male to reveal the secret life of the jaguar.

programme.title: Penguins: The African Chaplin
programme.desc: The African penguin is the only penguin species in Africa. Their clumsy demeanour has seen them called the Charlie Chaplins of the bird world. But they are struggling to escape extinction. Despite the protection of their breeding islands, numbers fall. Scientists race to find the answers for the staggering decline. Is there a glimmer of hope for the African Chaplin?

And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master

They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: Off Peak
programme.desc: Troy is one of the world's most iconic destinations. The ancient city in Turkey was the setting for the Iliad, the epic poem that tells the story of the final year of the Trojan War. The spotlight has been back on Troy this year with the release "The Odyssey", the much-acclaimed film that charts Odysseus' journey home after the Trojan War. We travel to present-day Canakkale, where Troy was located, to try to unravel fact from fiction, as well as discovering what the area has to offer out of peak season.

programme.title: Answering Tomorrow
programme.desc: It's been a devastating year for climate all over the world from droughts to forest fires and floods. Anna Stewart explores how we are preparing for the effects of climate change, and what we are doing to counteract them. From coral restoration projects in Abu Dhabi to tiny forest initiatives in London, we see how the world is adapting to climate change, as well as taking steps to mitigate it.

programme.title: Awyr Iach
programme.desc: Huw sy'n beicio yn Coed y Brenin gyda Gruff, Tryfan & Elen, bydd disgyblion Ysgol Penmachno yn plannu coed a Meleri sy'n ymuno a chriw o gasglwyr sbwriel Caerdydd. Planting trees & more.

programme.title: Pentre Papur Pop
programme.desc: Ar yr antur popwych heddiw mae Huwcyn yn mynd i wneud sioe hud a lledrith gwych! On today's poptastic adventure, Hooper is putting on a spectacular magic show!

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Mae ymbarel Tanwen, cyflwynydd y tywydd, wedi torri. Mae hi'n gwneud apêl yn fyw ar y teledu ac aiff Harri ac Alex i'w helpu. Tanwen, the weather forecaster's umbrella has broken. Help!

programme.title: Blwi
programme.desc: Mae Mam yn mynd i barti 'baby shower' felly Dad sy'n gyfrifol am y merched heno. When Mum goes out for the evening,Dad takes charge of the girls' evening routine.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach Ni
programme.desc: Heddiw ry' ni am ymweld â chyfandir Ewrop ac yn teithio i wlad Groeg i fwyta bwyd fel olewydd a Moussaka, ymweld â'r brifddinas Athens, a dysgu am y Groegiaid Gynt. Today a trip to Greece!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mae pont Swopdre Fawr ar fin dymchwel - a fydd Mojo a Bo yn gallu helpu Nori ei thrwsio mewn pryd? Swoppiton Bridge is falling down, can Mojo and Bo help Nori fix a girder in time?

programme.title: Ne-wff-ion
programme.desc: Mae Ysgol Gymraeg Y Trallwng yn hen a llawn a phawb eisiau ysgol newydd; heddiw cawn glywed beth yw eu cynlluniau i newid hyn. We hear if Ysgol Gymraeg Y Trallwng are getting a new school.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd, ac mae'n angyfforddus ar ei fatres newydd. Mae'r fatres fel petai'n hedfan! Pablo's new matress feels a bit odd - almost as if it is flying!

programme.title: Sigldigwt
programme.desc: Mae Gwesty Sigldigwt ar agor! Heddiw cawn gwrdd â Shani y poni ac Annie a'i chwn defaid. Today we meet Shani the pony and Annie and her sheep dogs.

programme.title: Twm Twrch
programme.desc: Mae dyfais dad-heneiddio newydd Mishmosh yn achosi trafferth! Mishmosh's new de-aging device causes problems!

programme.title: Annibendod
programme.desc: Rhaid meddwl sut i godi arian i brynu offer chwaraeon newydd rhag ofn na fydd Gari Gofalwr yn gallu'i trwsio. A plan is needed to raise money to replace the broken sports equipment.

programme.title: Ger a Gu
programme.desc: Pan mae hwyaden fach yn dilyn Gwen adref, mae'n rhaid i Ger a Gu ddod o hyd i'w theulu yn glou. When a little duckling follows Gwen home, Ger & Gu must return it to its family straight away.

programme.title: Dal Dy Ddannedd
programme.desc: Timau o Ysgol Bro Eirwg sy'n ymuno â Pwdryn a Melys i chwarae llond trol o gemau lliwgar! Teams from Ysgol Bro Eirwg join Pwdryn and Melys to play a series of candyland themed games.

programme.title: New: Penblwyddi Cyw
programme.desc: Cyfle i edrych 'nôl dros rai o gyfarchion pen-blwydd yr wythnos. A look back at some of this week's birthday greetings.

programme.title: Mynyddoedd y Byd: Corea
programme.desc: Stephen Evans sy'n mentro mas o Seoul i geisio deall pam bod yr uchelfannau mor agos at galonnau'r bobl. Stephen Evans asks why the mountains are so important to the citizens of South Korea.

programme.title: Hydref Gwyllt Iolo
programme.desc: Mae Iolo ar dir gwyllt trefol a pharciau, gyda gloÿnnod byw a gweision neidr yn hedfan am y tro olaf, a sgrech y coed yn claddu mes. This time: rutting deer, noisy jackdaws & little egrets.

programme.title: Y Deis
programme.desc: Cwis llawn gwybodaeth, strategaeth a bach o lwc! Yn cystadlu am y Jacpot mae timau o Gaerdydd, Llangefni a Phontypridd. Quiz that combines knowledge, strategy and luck!

programme.title: Cegin Clwyd Bryn Williams
programme.desc: Mae Bryn yn creu panna cotta mafon, ac yn galw heibio menter cadw moch Huw, fferm Pentrefelin. Bryn makes a raspberry panna cotta and calls by a new pig project run by Huw.

programme.title: Cerys Matthews a'r Goeden Faled
programme.desc: Bydd Cerys Matthews yn mynd ar drywydd dwy o ganeuon gwerin mwyaf adnabyddus Cymru - Dafydd y Garreg Wen, ac Y Mochyn Du. Cerys Matthews traces the history of two more Welsh folk songs.

programme.title: Cerys Matthews: Y Goeden Faled
programme.desc: Bydd Cerys yn troi ei sylw at Bachgen Bach o Dincar, cyn teithio i Gaernarfon i ddysgu am Llwyn Onn. Cerys Matthews looks into the history of the songs Bachgen Bach o Dincar and Llwyn Onn.

programme.title: Y Fets
programme.desc: Cyfres newydd. Tro hwn: trio achub coes ci defaid un o chwaraewyr rygbi Cymru, a thrin buwch a mul styfnig ar ffermydd lleol. New series. Terry the ferret and other animals need treatment.

programme.title: Stori'r Iaith - Cerys Matthews
programme.desc: Cyfres newydd. Cerys Matthews sy'n mynd ar daith bersonol i olrhain stori'r iaith Gymraeg. A new series. Cerys Matthews goes on a personal journey exploring the story of the Welsh language.

programme.title: Llond Bol o Japan
programme.desc: Mae Chris Flamebaster Roberts yn Japan lle mae'n cwrdd â meistr swshi ac yn ymweld â marchnad byd enwog Nishiki yn Kyoto. Chris Flamebaster is in Japan, ready to set his tastebuds ablaze!

programme.title: Trefi Gwyllt Iolo
programme.desc: Mae Iolo'n gweld llwynogod, moch daear a dyfrgwn yn crwydro yn y nos. Iolo sees foxes, badgers and otters roaming in the night and visits Wrexham, Haverfordwest, Carmarthen and Pembroke.

programme.title: Cyfrinachau'r Great Escape
programme.desc: Stori peilot o'r Ail Ryfel Byd sy'n datgelu gwybodaeth newydd am y ffilm 'The Great Escape'. The story of a pilot from WWII, which reveals new information about the film 'The Great Escape'.

programme.title: Ffermio
programme.desc: Pwysigrwydd cymorth cyntaf i ffermwyr a dau frawd sydd wedi dod i'r brig gyda'u buches godro. The importance of first aid for farmers and two brothers who have won with their dairy herd.

programme.title: New: Pobol y Cwm Omnibws
programme.desc: Cipolwg yn ôl dros ddigwyddiadau'r wythnos yng Nghwmderi. Omnibus edition looking back at the events in Cwmderi over the past week. With on-screen English subtitles.

programme.title: Newyddion S4C
programme.desc: Newyddion S4C a'r Tywydd. S4C News and Weather.

programme.title: New: Dechrau Canu Dechrau Canmol
programme.desc: Lowri Morgan sy'n Nheml Shree Swaminarayan Caerdydd yn profi llawenydd Gwyl Diwali. Lowri Morgan's in Shree Swaminarayan Temple Cardiff experiencing the joy of Diwali Festival.

programme.title: New: Cyrraedd Cymru
programme.desc: Seren sy'n olrhain hanesion pobl Asiaidd yng Nghymru, o feddygon i ffoaduriaid, a'u hetifeddiaeth. Seren explores Asian stories in Wales, from doctors to refugees, and their lasting legacy.

programme.title: Glyndwr: Gobaith a Gwaed
programme.desc: Drama-ddogfen emosiynol am Glyndwr, o frwydro Coron Lloegr i'w ddiflaniad dirgel. Emotional docudrama about Glyndwr, from his rebellion against the English to his mysterious disappearance.

programme.title: Prosiect Pum Mil
programme.desc: Mae'r criw yn nhref Rhydaman yr wythnos hon i helpu cangen Derwen Newydd o elusen y Wallich. The gang are in Ammanford this week to help the Derwen Newydd branch of the Wallich charity.

programme.title: Teulu Shadog: Tymhorau'r Flwyddyn
